J Infect Dis 1998; 178: 992–9. Postherpetic neuralgia. A 46-year-old HIV patient with chronic, treatment-resistant postherpetic neuralgia (p.9) received 1 cycle of subcutaneous interleukin-2 (7.5 million units twice daily for 5 consecutive days) within the context of a clinical HIV study. He reported immediate resolution of his postherpetic neu- ralgia, and no recurrence of pain occurred during 3 years of follow-up.1 1. Rotty J, et al.
